messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — prod-east-1 — kv-prefix-cache size growing >90% and /generate p95 latency spike across several routes. Alerting oncall.
mira: oncall here, looking. graphs look like cache cardinality jump starting ~1954320800, memory pressure on runtime pods.
devin: i'm seeing continuous-batching queue lengths jump too. suspect batching + prefix-key collisions. traces show a lot of cache misses but same logical templates.
alex: quick check — did we ship tokenizer v2 yesterday? that would change tokenization and hence prompt-prefix hashes.
jordan: yes, tokenizer v2 went to prod-east-1 at 1954270000 in a canary, then rolled to 100% ~1954300000. CS hasn't flagged anything yet.
mira: ok that lines up. if tokenizer changed, prefix key salt mismatch could make identical user templates have different prefix bytes -> cache churn + blowup.
devin: confirm. sample keys from redis show a mix of old-format and new-format hashes. we probably introduced a change to how we compute prefix hash (removed tokenizer version salt). that explains churn.
alex: mitigation plan: 1) throttle continuous batching to reduce pressure 2) increase cache default TTL temporarily 3) hotfix to canonicalize prefix hashing (include tokenizer_version) and run controlled migration job 4) notify customers.
mira: immediate action — throttling batching now.
mira: >>> kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=false  # rolling restart
deploy-bot: Started rollout: runtime -> prod-east-1 (restart triggered by mira). rollout id: r-9a1c
devin: increasing KV prefix TTL to 24h for prod-east-1 to avoid eviction storm while we stabilize.
alex: preparing migration job to rebuild prefix keys with tokenizer_version appended so old/new keys co-exist during migration. example key logic we want:

```
# desired stable key
key = sha256(prefix_bytes + b"|" + tokenizer_version.encode()).hexdigest()
```

we'll then backfill new keys for hot prefixes and keep old keys as fallback for 48h.
jordan: i'm drafting a CS message just in case. can you give me a short impact blurb?
eve-cs: customer impact: some customers experiencing intermittent 4-6x latency spikes and a few requests hitting 503s during peak. not widespread yet. i'll queue an email and update status page.
mira: deploy-bot shows runtime pods restarting, now monitoring p95.
devin: p95 falling back to normal in two pods. queue depth lower. KV size growth rate slowed.
alex: pushing hotfix branch: prefix-cache-fix — small change to include tokenizer_version and a migration script. tests pass locally. planning rolling deploy to canary first.

```
# patch snippet
- key = sha256(prefix.encode()).hexdigest()
+ key = sha256(prefix.encode() + b":" + tokenizer_version.encode()).hexdigest()
```

alex: also adding a safety guard in cache lookup: try new-key, fallback to old-key to avoid immediate misses.
mira: canary deploy to 2 pods in prod-east-1 now.
deploy-bot: Deployed runtime v1.2.8-canary to prod-east-1-canary (2 pods).
devin: canary looks good for 5m. p95 for canary pods stable, redis hit ratio improved.
alex: starting backfill job with dry-run first:

```
python scripts/regen_prefix_keys.py --dry-run --limit 5000 --region prod-east-1
```

alex: dry-run shows ~2.4k hot prefixes that will be backfilled rapidly.
mira: run backfill with rate-limit 200/s and monitor mem/cpu. start it now.

deploy-bot: Started job regen-prefix-1954321000 (rate 200/s).
alex: backfill first 1k done, no errors. memory usage fine.
devin: keeping continuous batching disabled until backfill completes + another stability window (30m).
jordan: CS update sent to impacted customers. sending triage note to account owners.
eve-cs: got acknowledgements from two customers, they appreciate the quick ops update.
mira: will handoff to devin for next-shift monitoring. devin, take the pager — i'll summarize in #incidents handoff doc.
devin: taking pager. current state: batching off, TTL 24h, canary hotfix deployed, backfill running. monitoring p95 and redis cardinality. contact me if regressions.
mira: short postmortem TODOs: - root cause writeup (tokenizer->prefix hashing mismatch) - incident timeline - mitigation steps and rollback playbook - add unit tests around prefix key construction - ensure deploy checklist flags tokenizer changes
alex: after backfill completes we'll remove old-key fallback in 48h and revert TTL. scheduling follow-up runbook PR.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager acknowledged by mira. Handoff to devin at 1954322200. Incident severity lowered to SEV-2.
mira: thanks all. closing thread here, will attach logs and commands in handoff doc. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
